about: Framing review: two review types per Wikipedia summary, shown separately. Overall fairness is the reviewer's judgement of emphasis, balance and omissions; the wording check cites Wikipedia's own neutrality and wording guidelines. Shown next to the summary, never merged into it. Not a fact-check and not a verdict on the events.
reviewer: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), an AI model made by Anthropic. Not checked line by line by a person.
